`final class GlVertexInput`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.vertex` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlVertexInput.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/vertex/GlVertexInput.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The vertex buffer of the OpenGL render bridge, with the vertex array that points every attribute of JOID at it.

## Description

Without vertex arrays, the attributes are pointed again at each draw.

- [Capabilities and paths](/build/base-modules/opengl/#capabilities-and-paths)
